name: Nirlon Ltd
title: Nirlon Ltd - 500307 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Fully leased NKP park (99.7% occupancy) with contracted escalations; FY26 PAT +59% flattered by Rs 69.5 cr deferred-tax write-back, ex-item growth ~27%; management evasive on cash of ~Rs 278-287 cr parked in FDs and on the 5% debt amortisation.

utilisation.quote: the average occupancy rate for the company as a whole comprising NKP and Ni rlon House stood at 99.7% for the 4th Quarter

capex.quote: nothing significant in terms of capex outside the park

triggers.label: Occupancy 99.7% in Q4
triggers.quote: the average occupancy rate for the company as a whole comprising NKP and Ni rlon House stood at 99.7%

triggers.label: Dividend raised Rs 26 to Rs 30
triggers.quote: You will appreciate that we have increased from Rs. 26 to Rs. 30

triggers.label: Cash idle, no plan for debt repayment
triggers.quote: As of now, there is nothing concrete or no concrete plans to pay back any debt from the existing cash balances.

guidance.quote: the Board proposes a final dividend of Rs. 15 per share for FY26

red_flags.label: Idle cash ~Rs 278-300 cr vs HSBC debt ~Rs 1150 cr at 7.75%
red_flags.quote: What is the rationale behind depositing 287 crore at just 5.5% and paying 7.75% interest on the HSBC loan

red_flags.label: Repeated evasion on REIT, buyback, and cash use
red_flags.quote: I don't want to preclude any other options at this point in time.

red_flags.label: EBITDA margin down 78.36% vs 79.33%; expenses +11% vs income +5.9%
red_flags.quote: EBITDA margin is 78.36 as compared to 79.33

evasions.topic: Use of idle cash / special dividend
evasions.quote: we cannot speculate at this point in time whether we will pay a special dividend or what we will do.
I don't want to answer any questions in isolation
We don't want to make a speculative comment
No. After that, there is nothing significant because there are not many renewals coming up in 2026-27.
